subject: website
name: Wikipedia on Swarm
summary: A searchable Wikipedia snapshot on Swarm: one hand-written page served as written, so its source is public (no licence file), and it runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: typing in the search box reads the article index from the public Swarm gateway api.gateway.ethswarm.org by default, or from a local node.

connections.name: Swarm gateway (api.gateway.ethswarm.org)
connections.note: Used when the visitor types in the search box; the Local option points at localhost:1633.
